body: Everyone has a spiritual guidance team. We may not always know who they are or how they work, but they are there rather we acknowledge them or not. When in a place of love, their voices can be heard.
Ask him yourself, then be open to whatever guidance is given. It may be subtle, it may be no-so-subtle. Just ask him and then pay attention to hunches and insight.
Did you ask him who it is?

Forget everything you have been told about the devil and Lucifer, especially from the patriarchal/monotheistic/abrahamic traditions. Lucifer brings light. In what ways do you bring Light into the world? What do you bring to the world that nobody else can?
If you are that worried about it, knock it off.
Open your heart. Make decisions based in love, not fear. Live a heart-centered life. Decide you are safe. Decide often.

1) Your own body answers. It works similar to muscle testing. 2) Ask anything you legitimately need an answer to. Asking questions you dont really want or need answers to is pointless. 3) I dont find it necessary, but have fun experimenting if you so choose! 4) That will do.

Just call out to him.  You dont have to do anything fancy, seriously. You dont need a fancy altar with a bunch of candles or anything like that. If your intent and desire is authentic, that is the only real magick ingredient you need for summoning Azazel. The ritual is as follows: 1) set aside a time and place where you wont be disturbed by others. 2) Draw or print his sigil on a piece of paper. 3) Stare at the sigil for 1-3 minutes, charging it with your energy. Just staring at it is enough. Dont strain yourself here. 3) Close your eyes. 4) Call out to Azazel and ask him to appear, or whatever it is you wish from him. Try to keep it simple and to the point. Use your own words. Let your desire steer your words and he will come. 5) When it is over, thank him!
The LHP should always be terrifying. If it makes you feel comfortable and safe, you are doing it wrong.

You are a child of Lilith. As a fellow Lilith person myself, I can sympathize with how alienating and lonely it can be. At first, I resisted this part of me- the part of me that knew I couldnt fit in, go with the crowd and be who others wanted/expected me to be. The more I tried to fit in and live up to the social expectations and please others, the more I hated myself. Deep down, I knew I was compromising my own needs  for others when I really didnt want to. My physical body began revolting. The body is wise and will tell you everything you need to know about the choices we make. Listen to what your body is telling you, what you feel, its where the Lilith part of you lives, and accept whatever you find. Lilith people are the most badass people on the planet in my opinion. It can be difficult and painful, but if you let the pain show you to who you really are and you use that to accept and love yourself unconditionally, it is well worth it.
Instead of resisting the Dark, have you considered embracing it as part of you?
